Transportation
Adana, due to its location, is a city with easy access by road, railway
*
, and air. It offers direct bus services from almost all cities in Türkiye, as well as direct or connecting transportation options via trains and flights from many central points. The Mithat ÖZSAN Amphitheatre, where the congress will be held, is located in the Balcalı Campus, approximately 8 km away from the city centre.
*
Please check the railway transportation availability for your convenience as speed-train construction is in progress
.
Bus Transportation:
By bus, you can reach the
Adana Intercity Bus Terminal
, which is 5 kilometres away from the city centre, and from there, you can easily reach the city centre. Within the terminal, there are
shuttles
operated by bus companies,
taxis
, or you can take
minibuses (dolmuş)
or
municipal buses
from the
main road
outside the terminal to reach the city centre. From
İnönü Parkı
or
Atilla ALTIKAT
area, you can easily reach the
Mithat ÖZSAN Amphitheatre
by taking minibuses numbered
4
or
4/B
, or
orange-coloured Balcalı buses
.
Air Transportation:
Transportation from
Çukurova International Airport (COV)
, which serves Adana and the surrounding region, is available through various alternatives. The airport is located approximately
35 km
from Adana city centre and about
45 km
from Çukurova University campus.
From the airport, you can reach the city centre or the university by
taxi
or
airport shuttle services
operating to Adana. Public transportation options also connect the airport to central points in the city.
Once in the city centre, the university campus can be reached by
municipal buses
,
minibuses (dolmuş)
, or other local transportation services. Minibuses numbered
4
and
4/B
departing from
İnönü Parkı
or the
Atilla Altıkat
area, as well as the orange-coloured
Balcalı buses
, provide access to the campus. After entering the campus,
campus transportation vehicles
can be used to reach the
Mithat Özsan Amphitheatre
.
Train Transportation:
Adana Train Station
, located approximately 1.5 km away from the city centre and in a very central location, offers various transportation options to reach the campus. From the station, you can reach the campus by taxi, or you can take
municipal buses
coming to Balcalı Campus from
Atatürk Caddesi
, which is just a few minutes' walk away, or
orange-coloured Balcalı buses
from
Gazipaşa Bulvarı
.
NOTE:
Those opting for municipal buses for transportation can make contactless payments with a credit card or obtain a single-use card from the kiosks near the stops.
